```{r}
# Load the two source surfaces used by this prototype. The profile file holds
# slow-changing personal information; activity data remains in the validated
# academic database so the CV cannot drift from the dashboard.
profile <- yaml::read_yaml("profile.yml")
awards <- readr::read_csv("../data/awards.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
grants <- readr::read_csv("../data/grants.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
memberships <- readr::read_csv("../data/professional_memberships.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
service <- readr::read_csv("../data/service.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
reviewers <- readr::read_csv("../data/reviewer_relationships.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
teaching <- readr::read_csv("../data/teaching.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
mentoring <- readr::read_csv("../data/mentoring.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
advising <- readr::read_csv("../data/advising_load.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Fail loudly if either source is unexpectedly empty. A generated CV that
# silently drops a section would be more dangerous than a failed render.
stopifnot(length(profile$person$name) == 1L, nzchar(profile$person$name))
stopifnot(nrow(awards) > 0L)
stopifnot(nrow(grants) > 0L, !anyDuplicated(grants$id))
stopifnot(nrow(memberships) > 0L, nrow(service) > 0L, nrow(reviewers) > 0L)
stopifnot(nrow(teaching) > 0L, nrow(mentoring) > 0L, nrow(advising) > 0L)

# Convert blank granting-body values to an empty string before composing the
# display text. This keeps the CSV schema unchanged and avoids rendering "NA".
awards$granting_body[is.na(awards$granting_body)] <- ""
awards$display_text <- ifelse(
  nzchar(awards$granting_body),
  paste0(awards$award_name, ", ", awards$granting_body),
  awards$award_name
)

# Render a single year for ordinary honors and an en-dash range only when the
# validated source supplies end_year. This avoids parsing prose in notes or
# hard-coding a Quality Matters exception in the CV layer.
awards$display_period <- ifelse(
  is.na(awards$end_year),
  as.character(awards$year),
  paste0(awards$year, "–", awards$end_year)
)
awards <- awards[order(awards$year, decreasing = TRUE), ]

# Prepare funding records using only validated database fields. Status controls
# current/previous grouping, so the CV updates automatically when an award's
# lifecycle changes in grants.csv.
grants$cv_group <- ifelse(
  grants$status == "funded",
  "Current",
  ifelse(grants$status == "completed", "Previous", "Other")
)
grants <- grants[order(as.Date(grants$start_date), decreasing = TRUE), ]

# Expand the database's compact role vocabulary only in the presentation layer.
# Unknown future values fall back to their stored text rather than disappearing.
role_labels <- c(
  "MPI" = "Multiple Principal Investigator",
  "PI" = "Principal Investigator",
  "Co-I" = "Co-Investigator",
  "Site PI" = "Site Principal Investigator",
  "Consultant" = "Consultant",
  "Key Personnel" = "Key Personnel"
)

format_cv_date <- function(value) {
  format(as.Date(value), "%m/%d/%Y")
}

format_cv_currency <- function(value) {
  paste0("$", format(round(value), big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE), " total")
}

# Format partial career-history dates consistently across memberships, service,
# teaching, and mentoring. A missing end year means the activity is ongoing;
# a one-year activity is shown once instead of as a repeated range.
format_year_range <- function(start_year, end_year) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(end_year),
    paste0(start_year, "–Present"),
    ifelse(start_year == end_year, as.character(start_year), paste0(start_year, "–", end_year))
  )
}

# Emit pipe tables through one helper so every generated section uses the same
# Markdown behavior and none of the source records are manually duplicated.
render_table <- function(data, column_names, align = NULL) {
  if (nrow(data) == 0L) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  if (is.null(align)) {
    align <- rep("l", ncol(data))
  }
  cat(
    knitr::kable(
      data,
      format = "pipe",
      col.names = column_names,
      align = align
    ),
    sep = "\n"
  )
  cat("\n\n")
}

render_grant_group <- function(group_name) {
  group_rows <- grants[grants$cv_group == group_name, ]
  if (nrow(group_rows) == 0L) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  cat("### ", group_name, "\n\n", sep = "")
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(group_rows))) {
    grant <- group_rows[i, ]
    list_marker <- paste0(i, ". ")
    continuation_indent <- strrep(" ", nchar(list_marker))
    header_parts <- c(
      paste(format_cv_date(grant$start_date), format_cv_date(grant$end_date), sep = "–")
    )
    if (!is.na(grant$award_number) && nzchar(grant$award_number)) {
      header_parts <- c(header_parts, grant$award_number)
    }
    if (!is.na(grant$total_cost)) {
      header_parts <- c(header_parts, format_cv_currency(grant$total_cost))
    }

    cat(list_marker, "**", paste(header_parts, collapse = " | "), "**\n\n", sep = "")
    cat(continuation_indent, grant$sponsor, ": “", grant$title, "”\n\n", sep = "")
    if (!is.na(grant$project_summary) && nzchar(grant$project_summary)) {
      cat(continuation_indent, "Summary: ", grant$project_summary, "\n\n", sep = "")
    }
    if (!is.na(grant$lead_investigator) && nzchar(grant$lead_investigator)) {
      cat(continuation_indent, grant$lead_investigator_role, ": ", grant$lead_investigator, "\n\n", sep = "")
    }

    role_label <- unname(role_labels[grant$role])
    if (is.na(role_label)) {
      role_label <- grant$role
    }
    effort_label <- if (!is.na(grant$effort_percent)) {
      paste0(" (", format(grant$effort_percent, trim = TRUE), "%)")
    } else {
      ""
    }
    cat(continuation_indent, "Role: ", role_label, effort_label, "\n\n", sep = "")
  }
}

# Prepare repeated display fields once. These derived columns belong in the CV
# layer because they describe presentation, not new source facts.
memberships$period <- format_year_range(memberships$start_year, memberships$end_year)
memberships <- memberships[order(memberships$start_year, decreasing = TRUE), ]

service$period <- format_year_range(service$start_year, service$end_year)
service$organization_display <- ifelse(
  is.na(service$notes) | !nzchar(service$notes),
  service$organization,
  paste0(service$organization, ". ", service$notes)
)
service <- service[order(service$start_year, decreasing = TRUE), ]

teaching$period <- format_year_range(teaching$start_year, teaching$end_year)
teaching$course_display <- paste0(teaching$course_code, " – ", teaching$course_title)
teaching$details <- ifelse(
  is.na(teaching$notes) | !nzchar(teaching$notes),
  paste(teaching$department, teaching$course_display, sep = "; "),
  paste(teaching$department, teaching$course_display, teaching$notes, sep = "; ")
)
teaching <- teaching[order(teaching$start_year, decreasing = TRUE), ]

mentoring$period <- format_year_range(mentoring$start_year, mentoring$end_year)
mentoring <- mentoring[order(mentoring$start_year, decreasing = TRUE), ]

# Committee rows store other advisors in a consistent role_detail prefix. Brad-
# advised rows are explicit booleans, so his name does not need to be duplicated
# in the CSV. This is the only normalization needed for the committee display.
mentoring$advisor_display <- ifelse(
  mentoring$primary_advisor,
  "Brad Cannell, PhD, MPH",
  sub("^Primary Advisor: ", "", mentoring$role_detail)
)
```

```{r, results='asis'}
# Render the contact block from profile.yml. Markdown remains the reviewable
# generated artifact; later passes can add DOCX-specific styling without
# changing the underlying content source.
cat("# ", profile$person$name, "\n\n", sep = "")
cat(profile$person$affiliation, "  \n", sep = "")
cat(profile$person$address[[1]], "  \n", sep = "")
cat(profile$person$address[[2]], "  \n", sep = "")
cat(profile$person$phone_office, " office", sep = "")
if (!is.null(profile$person$phone_mobile) && nzchar(profile$person$phone_mobile)) {
  cat(" | ", profile$person$phone_mobile, " mobile", sep = "")
}
cat("  \n")
cat("[", profile$person$email, "](mailto:", profile$person$email, ")\n\n", sep = "")
```

## Honors and Awards

```{r, results='asis'}
# Use a plain Markdown table for the first thin slice. The generator displays
# exactly what is in awards.csv and deliberately avoids CV-only exceptions.
cat(
  knitr::kable(
    awards[c("display_period", "display_text")],
    format = "pipe",
    col.names = c("Year", "Honor or award"),
    align = c("l", "l")
  ),
  sep = "\n"
)
```

## Professional Memberships

```{r, results='asis'}
render_table(
  memberships[c("period", "organization")],
  c("Period", "Organization")
)
```

## Service Activities

```{r, results='asis'}
# Preserve the CV's community/university/profession hierarchy while using the
# database's current role roster and notes.
service_group_labels <- c(
  "community" = "Service to the Community",
  "university" = "Service to the University",
  "profession" = "Service to the Profession"
)
for (category in names(service_group_labels)) {
  cat("### ", service_group_labels[[category]], "\n\n", sep = "")
  group_rows <- service[service$category == category, c("period", "role", "organization_display")]
  render_table(group_rows, c("Period", "Role", "Organization or activity"))
}
```

### Editorial and Reviewing Activities

```{r, results='asis'}
review_group_labels <- c(
  "editorial-board" = "Editorial Boards",
  "ad-hoc-reviewer" = "Journal Reviews",
  "software-reviewer" = "Software Reviews"
)
for (relationship_type in names(review_group_labels)) {
  cat("#### ", review_group_labels[[relationship_type]], "\n\n", sep = "")
  group_rows <- reviewers[reviewers$relationship_type == relationship_type, c("journal_or_venue", "status")]
  render_table(group_rows, c("Journal or venue", "Status"))
}
```

## Teaching Experience

```{r, results='asis'}
# Group courses by institution to retain the Word CV's teaching hierarchy. The
# notes field carries the University of Florida teaching-assistant clarification.
for (institution in unique(teaching$institution)) {
  cat("### ", institution, "\n\n", sep = "")
  group_rows <- teaching[teaching$institution == institution, c("period", "details")]
  render_table(group_rows, c("Period", "Department and course"))
}
```

```{r, results='asis'}
render_table(

)
```

```{r, results='asis'}
committee_rows <- mentoring[

  c("mentee_name", "period", "degree_or_context", "advisor_display")
]
render_table(
  committee_rows,
```

```{r, results='asis'}
)
```

### Other Mentoring

```{r, results='asis'}
other_mentoring_labels <- c(
  "external-mentee" = "External Mentees",
  "postdoc-mentee" = "Postdoctoral Mentees",
  "faculty-mentee" = "Faculty Mentees"
)
for (role in names(other_mentoring_labels)) {
  cat("#### ", other_mentoring_labels[[role]], "\n\n", sep = "")
  group_rows <- mentoring[
    mentoring$role == role,
    c("mentee_name", "period", "degree_or_context", "role_detail")
  ]
  render_table(
    group_rows,
    c("Name", "Period", "Context", "Mentorship role")
  )
}
```

```{r, results='asis'}
render_grant_group("Current")
render_grant_group("Previous")
```
